ChangeRequest.description:
A change request: the record's own fields (summary, window, risk, plan, state, and the
decision once made) are the ITSM body, open by nature; the fields below are the platform's.
ChangeRequest.title: ChangeRequest

Decision.description:
A sign-off decision. Extra keys are refused, so a body cannot name another actor or role
(FR-002): the decision is always the signed-in person's.
Decision.title: Decision

DecisionForm.description:
What this person may decide and what each outcome needs (``adlc.inbox.forms``).

Every value comes from the pinned spec and catalogues, so none is a literal here.
DecisionForm.title: DecisionForm

Kpi.description:
One KPI (``adlc.dashboard.kpis``); its value's form depends on the KPI (a number, a
breakdown or nothing yet), and some KPIs add a per-terminal split, details or a note.
Kpi.title: Kpi

LaneBar.description: A run in a lane, or several earlier runs collapsed into one bar (``collapsed`` set).
LaneBar.title: LaneBar

ProposedEvent.description: A proposal row of the run's artifact table (its values as the agent wrote them).
ProposedEvent.title: ProposedEvent

RunArtifact.description: One artifact of the terminal: its rows as stored (a table, text or nothing yet).
RunArtifact.title: RunArtifact

RunSummary.description: A run at a glance (``adlc.inbox.service.run_summary``); the answer of every run action.
RunSummary.title: RunSummary

schema.title: Response Dead Letters Dead Letters Get
Response History Runs  Run Id  Artifacts  Artifact Id  History Get

200.description: The file, as a download (Content-Disposition: attachment)

post.description: Any signed-in person may verify a use case's chain; the run is recorded under them.
